repos_data.description: Python and TypeScript SDKs for Algenta — self-hosted building blocks for AI applications. 6,000+ deterministic functions on custom Mojo kernels behind one API, SDK and MCP surface; no new language to learn. The engine is proprietary; the SDKs, API contract and examples are Apache-2.0. Siblings: thyn-ai/algenta-integrations, thyn-ai/mojo-kernels.
